name: Oregon_Natural_Gas_and_Electric_Utility_Incentive_Layer_Update_13Dec2024_v01
title: Oregon Natural Gas and Electric Utility Service Areas
description:
The Oregon Department of Energy has compiled electric and natural gas utility service areas. The layer is included in our Find Your Utility tool - available here: ODOE - Find Your Utility Tool. We include utility contact information, a link to the main webpage, and utility webpage. The tool is used to search by address or select an area on the map to learn more about your location's electric and/or natural gas utility. Follow utility website links to learn about their services, including potential incentive programs for energy projects. If you notice any gaps in coverage or inaccurate service areas, then please contact GIS.ODOE@energy.oregon.gov with your observation and a map showing the correct boundary. 

We regularly update utility service areas. See below for an update log:
19Aug2025: Avista Oregon Natural Gas Service Areas
snippet: A combined layer of ODOE's natural gas and electric layers with the utility companies respective website link, website incentive link, and phone number.
